description.description: Brief MC-facing summary of what this Danger is and how it threatens the crew. Supports inline Markdown.
examples: Enforcers are based on the Hired Thugs Mundane Danger with the addition of the **Juiced Up** move, which represents their enhanced physical state.
The detective may be working against the crew, helping the crew, or she may be a rival of the crew. Adjust the {corrupt:} and {override-authority:} spectrums accordingly.

rating.description: General estimate of how dangerous this profile is (0-5).

spectrums.description: Define how the Danger can be overcome, transformed, countdown toward an end, or ignore certain approaches.

name.description: Action to undertake in order to overcome the Danger or to transform it meaningfully.

maximum.description: Tier that relevant statuses need to reach in order to overcome the Danger or to transform it meaningfully.

is_immune.description: If true, the Danger ignores statuses targeting this Spectrum's vector.

items.description: Tracks how much of a given type of status a Danger can take before it changes irrevocably.

soft_moves.description: Describe the actions the Danger can take to complicate the scene without direct rules impact.

items.description: Predefined variations of the soft MC move Complicate Things. They describe an action the Danger can take to complicate things which changes the story without affecting the rules directly.

hard_moves.description: Describe the actions the Danger can take which have direct mechanical impact.

items.description: Predefined variations of the hard MC moves which can be invoked when the MC makes a hard move using the Danger specifically.

custom_moves.description: Condition-plus-outcome rules for special abilities or circumstances.

name.description: Short title for the custom move.

description.description: Concise text that explains both the conditions that trigger the custom move and its outcomes.
examples: When the Golem of Prague enters the scene, give it {hardened-skin-1}.
When you try to get into the castle of the Sleeping Beauty, you first take {entangled-3} or {nick-and-cuts-2}, MC's choice.

items.description: A custom and unique condition-plus-outcome rule tailored to a specific ability or circumstance regarding the Danger.

meta.description: Attribution and cataloging fields for the Danger's origin.

publication_type.description: Classifies the Danger's source to aid cataloging and tooling.

source.description: Source title (book, supplement, PDF) where this Danger appears.
examples: Lantern in the Mist - Sample Dangers

authors.description: List of credited authors or contributors.

page.description: Page number (if relevant to the source).

description: City of Mist - Danger profile, representing a threat, obstacle, victim, hazard, or group with spectrums and danger moves.
